channel.title: Citizen News & Media Limited - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Citizen News & Media Limited (hackneycitizen.co.uk)

item.title: Sadiq Khan set to fall short of affordable housing target
item.description: The Greater London Authority and Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government last year agreed to lower London’s affordable housing target

item.title: ‘You won today’ — protesters stop council from evicting Hackney family with disabled child
item.description: The family has lived at the property for more than 20 years, but the council says they have been illegally subletting and is reportedly looking to move them to temporary accommodation

item.title: Stoke Newington venue under threat as bosses scramble to ‘save’ historic space
item.description: The Old Church’s director says urgent repair work is needed to secure the future of the much-loved music venue

item.title: Exclusive: The Mossbourne money-spinner – how a company founded by the multi-academy trust’s chief snapped up his own schools’ lucrative PAM software
item.description: To fund the purchase, Progress Teaching gave Mossbourne Foundation £300,000 worth of its shares and a promised payment of £268,000 by way of an unsecured loan

item.title: Mixed-gender Hackney football league watched by FA as they lead charge for inclusive sport
item.description: The Hackney-based Power League, started by a group of friends, could be paving the way for greater inclusivity in football

item.title: Londoners face ‘particular’ issues with shared ownership scheme says Housing Minister
item.description: Matthew Pennycook has previously said there are 'specific problems' with the scheme which must be addressed

item.title: Seven Hackney councillors to stand down at local elections
item.description: Seven councillors are standing down in Hackney ahead of May's local elections, including a London Assembly member

item.title: Young people don’t trust Met Police or feel safe in their area, report shows
item.description: An investigation found young Londoners “feel they are not believed by the police" and that "they are seen as a suspect first"

item.title: Zoë Garbett urges Met to ‘immediately stop’ use of ‘invasive’ facial recognition tools
item.description: The London Assembly Member and Hackney councillor has published a report outlining concerns over the use of Live Facial Recognition (LFR) technology by the Met

item.title: TfL ‘lacks depth and nuance’ in efforts to make transport accessible to disabled people
item.description: Elly Baker, chair of the Transport Committee, said TfL was 'resting on its laurels' when it came to disability inclusion on its network
